name: Woodcraft

categories.label: Score track (during play)
categories.hint: Points from orders, income phases, and abilities; add 50/100/150 markers.

categories.label: Public contracts claimed
categories.labelVi: Hợp đồng công khai đã nhận
categories.hint: Full printed value of each public contract you claimed, even if shared.

categories.label: Leftovers (unused dice, blueberries, scrapwood, glue, saw tokens)
categories.hint: Add values of unused dice + blueberries + scrapwood/glue/saw tokens; 1 VP per 10.

categories.label: Completed orders x reputation space value
categories.labelVi: Đơn hoàn thành x mức uy tín
categories.hint: Reputation value after -2 per unfilled order, times completed orders (max 6 each).

tiebreakers.description: The player who played later in every round wins; the starting player always loses ties.

notes: family: point-salad-euro. Unfilled orders beside your board each cost 2 reputation spaces (reputation can't go below the start space): move your reputation counter first, then read its point value. Game ends after the income phase of round 14.
